description: Verbindlichkeiten / offene Posten: today's open and partially paid expense vouchers (Belege, Ausgaben) by days past their payment deadline (Fälligkeit) on asOf (Stichtag, today or later): not due, 1–30, 31–60, 61–90, over 90 days, each with count and outstanding = gross − paid per currency, plus the top suppliers (Lieferanten). Use it to plan payments; sevdesk_vouchers_list shows the single vouchers. Transferred vouchers (Überwiesen) count as paid, recurring templates (RV) are left out; amounts without a usable paid figure are marked approximate or unknown. Computed by this server from sevDesk records, not a sevDesk report.

asOf.description: Reference day (Stichtag), YYYY-MM-DD, today or later; default today (Berlin). sevDesk only knows today's open items, so a past day is refused; a later day ages today's open items as of that day.

top.description: How many of the largest parties to list per currency.

title: Payables aging
